account.nameHint: A name helps the shop recognise your account. This is not the name on your delivery — that one is on your address.
account.householdBody: Many homes here share one phone. This account belongs to whoever signs in on it, but a delivery goes to the name on the address you choose at checkout — so you can order for anyone at home. Add an address in each person's name from My addresses.
account.changedNumberHint: Your number is how you sign in. Call the shop, tell us the old and the new number, and we will move your orders and your address across.
account.deleteIntro: Deleting your account removes your name, your phone number and your saved addresses for good. Your past orders stay with the shop as a record of sales, but they will no longer show your name, phone or address.
account.deleteWhatStays: What we keep: the order number, the items and the amounts, so the shop's accounts still add up. What we remove: everything that says who you are.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This cannot be undone. You will be signed out and will need a new account to order again.
account.deleteDoneBody: Your details are gone and you have been signed out. Your past orders stay with the shop with no name or phone on them. If you order again, it starts fresh. Thank you for shopping with us.
account.deleteErrorNotSignedIn: You are not signed in any more. Please sign in again.
account.deleteErrorOnlyAdmin: This is the shop's only owner account. Add a second owner before deleting it.
account.deleteErrorUnknown: Something went wrong and your account was not deleted. Please try again, or call the shop.

privacy.receiptFooterDefault: Thank you for shopping with the shop around the corner.
privacy.whatWeCollectBody: Your phone number, the name and address you give us for delivery, and what you order. If you turn on notifications, we also keep the token that lets us buzz your phone about your order. That is all.
privacy.whyBody: The phone number is how you sign in and how the rider or the shop reaches you. The address is where the bag goes. Your order history is how we show you what you bought and how the shop keeps its accounts.
privacy.whoSeesBody: The shop and the rider delivering your order. Your address is visible to the rider only while your order is on its way. We do not sell your information to anyone, and we do not run advertising in this app.
privacy.consentBody: You give this by signing in and placing an order, and you can take it back at any time by deleting your account. This notice is available in English and Kannada, whichever you are reading now, and you can switch at any time from Account.
privacy.keepBody: Your name, phone number and addresses are kept while you have an account. When you delete your account they are erased. We keep the bare record of past orders — the order number, the items and the amounts — because a shop must be able to show its sales, but after deletion those records no longer say who you are.
privacy.rightsBody: You can see what we hold, ask us to fix it, and ask us to erase it. The erase button is in Account, under Delete my account, and it works immediately. For anything else, call the shop.
privacy.termsBody: Prices and stock shown here come from the shop and can change; the price you are charged is the one confirmed when you place the order. Orders are paid in cash when the rider arrives. The shop may decline an order it cannot fulfil, and will tell you why. Delivery is only to the pincodes the shop serves, which are shown at checkout.
privacy.questionsBody: Call the shop. There is a real person at the other end, and for a shop on one street that is faster than a form.
